mechanism: Net creation of fiat-backed stablecoin supply represents deployable crypto-market liquidity. Large positive supply impulses may precede deployment into liquid crypto assets if capital is not absorbed instantaneously.

material_difference: This lab uses aggregate circulating supply change of USDT + USDC, not exchange inflow/outflow.
It does not test peg dislocation or depeg mean reversion.
It does not test DEX pool liquidity stress.
Primary economic object is new/removing stablecoin supply as a market-liquidity impulse.

outcome_boundary: No BTC or ETH price is requested during source gate.
No returns or PnL during source gate.
No live trading, wallet, exchange mutation or main merge.
